description: H has no key and two equal rows (1,'x'). Inside BeginTrans and rolled back, a dynaset over H: Updatable, per-field DataUpdatable, SourceTable and SourceField; read all rows; MoveFirst, Edit, assign B 'z', Update, Errors; Requery and read all rows; MoveFirst, Delete, Errors, Requery and read all rows; AddNew (2,'y'), Update, Errors, Requery and read all rows. Then the same edit and delete on a table-type recordset over H. Asks which of two equal heap rows an edit or delete reaches and what each refusal says. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
